title: Bimodal retrograde signaling disrupts a suppressor network and activates a key transcriptional activator to direct stress responses.
authors: Zeng, Liping; Guo, Jingzhe; Rodriguez, Carlos; Gomez-Mendez, Maria Fernanda; Wang, Yaqi; van de Ven, Wilhelmina; Palayam, Malathy; Pruneda-Paz, Jose; Shabek, Nitzan; Dehesh, Katayoon
journal: The Plant journal : for cell and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物逆行信号MEcPP通过调控HAT1-CAMTA3等转录因子与RSRE DNA元件的互作网络来激活应激基因表达，涉及AlphaFold建模的蛋白-DNA复合物结构，但核心是信号通路与遗传验证，AI/物理模拟方法仅辅助，非聚焦TF-DNA结合机制建模。
abstract: Plastid-to-nucleus communication, crucial for regulating stress-responsive gene expression, has long intrigued researchers. This study reveals how the plastidial metabolite 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol-2,4-cyclopyrophosphate (MEcPP) orchestrates transcriptional reprogramming by modulating the rapid stress response element (RSRE), a conserved regulatory hub in the plant general stress response network. Yeast one-hybrid assays identified HAT1, a class II HD-Zip protein, as a negative regulator of RSRE. Genetic analyses, including HAT1 overexpression and knockdowns, confirmed its role in suppressing RSRE activity. Interaction assays uncovered a suppression network involving HAT1, the co-repressor TOPLESS (TPL), and the nuclear importin IMPalpha-9. Furthermore, HAT1 interacts with calmodulin-binding transcription activator 3 (CAMTA3), a calcium/calmodulin-binding transcription factor known to activate RSRE. AlphaFold modeling provided insights into the architecture of the HAT1-RSRE complex and HAT-CAMTA3 interaction, supported by conserved domains across plant species. Under stress condition, MEcPP accumulation promotes the 26S proteasomal degradation of TPL and IMPalpha-9 while reduces auxin-dependent HAT1 expression. Additionally, MEcPP enhances Ca(2+) influx, activating CAMTA3 and enabling it to bind RSRE, thereby initiating the transcription of stress response genes. This dual mechanism-dismantling suppressors (HAT1, TPL, and IMPalpha-9) and activating CAMTA3-underscores MEcPP's central role in plastid-to-nucleus signaling. These findings emphasize MEcPP's pivotal function in dynamically regulating gene expression to maintain cellular homeostasis under environmental stress.
abstract_zh: 质体到细胞核的通讯，对于调控应激响应基因表达至关重要，长期以来一直引起研究者的浓厚兴趣。本研究揭示了质体代谢物2-C-甲基-D-赤藓醇-2,4-环焦磷酸酯（MEcPP）如何通过调节快速应激响应元件（RSRE）来协调转录重编程，RSRE是植物通用应激响应网络中的一个保守调控枢纽。酵母单杂交实验鉴定出HAT1，一种II类HD-Zip蛋白，作为RSRE的负调控因子。遗传分析，包括HAT1过表达和敲低，确认了其在抑制RSRE活性中的作用。相互作用实验揭示了一个涉及HAT1、共抑制因子TOPLESS（TPL）和核输入蛋白IMPalpha-9的抑制网络。此外，HAT1与钙调蛋白结合转录激活因子3（CAMTA3）相互作用，CAMTA3是一种已知能激活RSRE的钙/钙调蛋白结合转录因子。AlphaFold建模提供了HAT1-RSRE复合物和HAT-CAMTA3相互作用结构的见解，并得到跨植物物种保守结构域的支持。在应激条件下，MEcPP积累促进TPL和IMPalpha-9的26S蛋白酶体降解，同时减少生长素依赖的HAT1表达。此外，MEcPP增强Ca(2+)内流，激活CAMTA3并使其能够结合RSRE，从而启动应激响应基因的转录。这种双重机制——解除抑制因子（HAT1、TPL和IMPalpha-9）并激活CAMTA3——强调了MEcPP在质体到细胞核信号传导中的核心作用。这些发现突出了MEcPP在环境应激下动态调控基因表达以维持细胞稳态中的关键功能。
